assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The service is for the underlying diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0.
The service supports coverage eligibility under SilverBridge Advantage.
